report_topic: Performance Audit of Implementation of Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
observations_summary: The audit found systemic deficiencies in planning, employment generation, financial management, asset creation, monitoring, and social audit, with 86% of works in test-checked GPs lacking Gram Sabha approval and only 61% of sanctioned works completed. Significant human resource shortages, unpaid EPF contributions, and wasteful expenditure on idle assets further hampered the scheme's objectives.
